test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The table below shows the production of jute fabric (in lakh metre) by two Companies P and Q during 2001 to 2005. **Year** **Company P** **Company Q** 2001 100
solution:
**Calculation:**

In 2001, Company P produced 100 lakh metre, and Company Q produced 96 lakh metre. (P > Q)

In 2002, Company P produced 120 lakh metre, and Company Q produced 130 lakh metre. (Q > P)

In 2003, Company P produced 108 lakh metre, and Company Q produced 100 lakh metre. (P > Q)

In 2004, Company P produced 190 lakh metre, and Company Q produced 180 lakh metre. (P > Q)

In 2005, Company P produced 240 lakh metre, and Company Q produced 275 lakh metre. (Q > P)

**Therefore, Company Q produced more fabric than Company P in the years 2002 and 2005.**
